run_LM_transformer_training: run the lingua training loop for an LMTransformer model with distributed data parallel and gradient accumulation
configure_TrainArgs: configure a TrainArgs object with model, data, optimizer, distributed, checkpoint, profiling, and logging settings
manage_TrainState: manage the TrainState including optimizer step count, accumulation steps, scheduler, and dataloader state
validate_train_arguments: validate TrainArgs to check vocab size, dump directory, checkpoint path, data sources, and distributed world size
launch_training_with_cli: launch training via CLI by merging a config file with command line dot-list overrides using OmegaConf
